context.description_en: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
context.description_zh: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得治疗。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。
notes_en: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 对友军和敌人有效。对肉山无效。
回复量与造成伤害相互独立。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

context.description_en: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
context.description_zh: 血魔能够感知到敌人的伤口中涌出的鲜血，敌方英雄的生命值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%，他的移动速度就会提升，而且生命值越低，提升效果越大。如果生命值低于%invis_threshold_pct%%%，他还将获得该英雄的视野和真实视域。焦渴的效果可以叠加。血魔可以突破最大速度限制。
notes_en: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.
notes_zh: 幻象不能触发该技能。
移动速度加成在敌人生命值低于%max_bonus_pct%%%时达到上限。
目标死亡后效果延续%linger_duration%秒。

context.description_zh: 石鳞剑士孤注一掷，让命运决定敌人的下场。石鳞剑士的攻击或技能拥有一定几率大幅降低攻击速度，同时削弱护甲。

context.description_zh: 亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。对建筑的持续伤害减少%tower_dps_pct%%%。

context.description_en: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
context.description_zh: 斯温以巨力攻击，并对所有附近的敌方单位造成分裂攻击伤害。

subject: bristleback_bristleback

context.description_en: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
context.description_zh: 如果伤害来自钢背兽的侧面或者背后，他所受的伤害将会降低。钢背兽每次从背后受到一定量伤害会自动释放一次当前等级的刺针扫射。
notes_en: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 钢背兽的背面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈70度角的扇形区域。
钢背兽的侧面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈110度角的扇形区域，背面的扇形区域不算在内。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 钢毛后背增加主动效果。钢背兽将背部转向目标方向，%activation_delay%秒后以%activation_spray_interval%秒间隔朝背部前方的锥形范围强行连续喷出%activation_num_quill_sprays%次刺针扫射。钢背兽在这段时间内面朝方向被锁定，被缴械，并且移动速度减缓%activation_movement_speed_pct%%%。

subject: slark_essence_shift
definition: 被动技能（或技能的被动部分）会被破坏暂时失效；绝大多数被动都可被破坏，例外如美杜莎·魔法盾、小小·长大、米波·分则能成
definition_note: U33、U35：事实层只记“能否被破坏”；英雄有多怕破坏（依赖被动的程度）见knowledge/mechanics/break-vulnerable-heroes-v1.json（推导层）

evidence.quote: Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks.
evidence.value: Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.

context.description_en: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
context.description_zh: 斯拉克的攻击会偷走敌方英雄的生命能量，每次吸取他们的%stat_loss%点全属性并转化成自身额外%agi_gain%点敏捷值。只要敌方英雄带着该效果在斯拉克300范围内阵亡，他将永久窃取%stat_loss%点敏捷。
notes_en: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.
notes_zh: 属性值最少为1点。
斯拉克或受到作用的单位死亡后，阵亡单位因能量转移变化的属性值将回归正常。但是两方的属性值相互独立，并无关联。
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。
破坏会使技能无法获得临时的叠加效果。依然可以获得永久的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

subject: primal_beast_uproar
definition: 被动技能（或技能的被动部分）会被破坏暂时失效；绝大多数被动都可被破坏，例外如美杜莎·魔法盾、小小·长大、米波·分则能成

evidence.quote: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
evidence.value: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

context.description_en:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
context.description_zh:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过%damage_limit%点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续%roar_duration%秒。
notes_en: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
notes_zh: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

scepter_loc.en: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
scepter_loc.zh: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出%projectile_waves%波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有%projectiles_per_stack%个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

subject: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
definition: 被动技能（或技能的被动部分）会被破坏暂时失效；绝大多数被动都可被破坏，例外如美杜莎·魔法盾、小小·长大、米波·分则能成

context.description_en: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
shard_loc.zh: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。

evidence.value: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.

context.description_en: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
context.description_zh: 周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
notes_en: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。

subject: night_stalker_midnight_feast

context.description_en: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
context.description_zh: 暗夜魔王攻击敌方单位时治疗自身。在夜晚可以主动施放，秒杀一个非远古非英雄单位，并回复暗夜魔王的最大生命值和最大魔法值的一定百分比。
notes_en: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.
notes_zh: 攻击获得的生命值受到生命回复的影响，攻击非英雄目标时会减少。

context.description_en: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
context.description_zh: 每当受到攻击达到一定次数，军团指挥官都会对目标立即作出反击，而且此次攻击具有吸血效果。
notes_en: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.
notes_zh: 只有在攻击他人时受到攻击才会触发带有吸血的反击。

subject: necrolyte_sadist

evidence.value: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

context.description_en: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
context.description_zh: 瘟疫法师每次击杀单位都将获得可叠加的恢复效果，持续%regen_duration%秒。击杀英雄后获得数倍的效果。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。

subject: viper_corrosive_skin
definition: 被动技能（或技能的被动部分）会被破坏暂时失效；绝大多数被动都可被破坏，例外如美杜莎·魔法盾、小小·长大、米波·分则能成
definition_note: U33、U35：事实层只记“能否被破坏”；英雄有多怕破坏（依赖被动的程度）见knowledge/mechanics/break-vulnerable-heroes-v1.json（推导层）

context.description_en: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a %max_range% radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
context.description_zh: 蝮蛇分泌出感染性的毒素，%max_range%范围内任何伤害它的敌人都将受到伤害，同时攻击速度也被降低。这种酸性分泌物还能提高蝮蛇的魔法抗性。
notes_en: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
notes_zh: 与其他提升魔法抗性的物品和技能叠加。
破坏会使腐蚀皮肤不再施加效果。极恶俯冲还是会施加腐蚀皮肤。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Corrosive Skin applies %effect_multiplier%x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within %effect_multiplier_distance% distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to %nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%% increased effect after %nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙%effect_multiplier_distance%范围内的敌人施加%effect_multiplier%倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在%nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%秒后，达到最高的%nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%%提升。

subject: beastmaster_drums_of_slom
definition: 被动技能（或技能的被动部分）会被破坏暂时失效；绝大多数被动都可被破坏，例外如美杜莎·魔法盾、小小·长大、米波·分则能成

context.description_en: Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.
context.description_zh: 兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，%max_stacks%次攻击后降低至最短%min_drum_hit_interval%秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。使用原始咆哮时自动增加%primal_roar_stacks%层敲鼓叠加效果。
